claims: An underdog is a person, team, or entity expected to lose a competition, struggle, or matchup, with the anticipated winner known as the "favorite" or "top dog".
If an underdog wins, the result is called an "upset".
Underdog (1964–1967) was an animated show featuring the character Underdog.
Underdog (2007) is a Disney family film about a beagle with superpowers.
Underdog Fantasy is a daily fantasy sports (DFS) app.
Underdog Fantasy operates in 40 states, Washington DC, and Canada.
Underdog.io is a tech recruiting platform.
Underdog Sports Leagues is a recreational sports league organization
